strategy.name: 15m Opening Range Breakout
strategy.description: Opening range breakout on 1m bars (15-minute window) with ATR-based risk sizing, one trade per symbol per session.

notes: Generated from this revision of the gate.

parameter_effects.inputs.session_start: opening-range timing within the configured data session
parameter_effects.inputs.atr_length: ATR estimate used for stop/target distances and risk sizing
parameter_effects.inputs.atr_mult: risk sizing distance; intrabar stop/target execution is inactive
parameter_effects.inputs.target_atr_mult: profit-target distance independent of the stop; defaults to atr_mult when omitted. Only changes realized exits with stop_target policy.

notes: Results measure SPY underlying shares, not option contracts, premiums, Greeks or option fills.
Risk per trade is a position-sizing budget based on stop distance, not a guaranteed realized-loss cap.

The engine sizes from equity * risk_pct / 100 / stop_distance. max_units and gross-exposure gates REJECT oversized orders; they do not resize them. Use rejection counts to diagnose zero or few trades.
Compare measured returns and drawdown; reducing exposure alone does not establish a better entry signal.
ORB creates at most one candidate trade per symbol/session; changing daily trade limits above one cannot add signals.
ORB uses session-end strategy exits unless forced earlier. ATR multiplier changes sizing distance, not an active intrabar stop under this exit policy.
Daily kill only blocks subsequent entries. It does not close an existing position or cap its loss.
Commissions and slippage are all zero in this configuration; report that assumption.
